item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=computational+epistemology+techniques+for+detecting+internal+reasoning+fallacies&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.4135/9781526443625\", \"title\": [\"Understanding Fallacies and Seductive Abuse of Reasoning\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.4135/9781526443625\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2018]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.4324/9781315792675-7\", \"title\": [\"Some Common Reasoning Fallacies\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.4324/9781315792675-7\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2019, 6, 19]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.18653/v1/2026.findings-acl.1385\", \"title\": [\"Detecting Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Semantic-level Internal Reasoning Graph\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2026.findings-acl.1385\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.1775825\", \"title\": [\"Defeasible Reasoning and Informal Fallacies\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>This paper argues that some traditional fallacies should be considered as reasonable arguments when used as part of a properly conducted dialog. It is shown that argumentation schemes, formal dialog models, and profiles of dialog are useful tools for studying properties of defeasible reasoning and fallacies. It is explained how defeasible reasoning of the most common sort can deteriorate into fallacious argumentation in some instances. Conditions are formulated that can be used as normative tools to judge whether a given defeasible argument is fallacious or not. It is shown that three leading violations of proper dialog standards for defeasible reasoning necessary to see how fallacies work are: (a) improper failure to retract a commitment, (b) failure of openness to defeat, and (c) illicit reversal of burden of proof.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.1775825\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2011]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "60db0be3e7279b4d7199fe28818f465bbd6838d28c845f9b27c2b025ac4baa01", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "assumption_challenge", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.4135/9781526443625", "doi:10.4324/9781315792675-7", "doi:10.18653/v1/2…
